items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: John Handley was over late with me too. I had a good job over there.

ctx.x: Yeah, that sounds right. You passing cards on, man. Do you think it's right? No. I don't think it's right. You understand what I mean? Now, I never know me that too.

That's my little cousin, man. Course is way over in South America, Andy. You know Andy, say, here I play. John Handley. John Handley. John Handley was over late with me too. I had a good job over there. I was on Saturday. Man, when I go to the laboratory, man, man showed me a call.
I said, now you're not his, fellas.
